title: Ankita Bhandari's parents removed from Rajghat dharna

ai.summary: Bhandari's parents were removed from Rajghat dharna after staging a protest near Mahatma Gandhi's memorial, which police said was not a designated site.

facts.claim: Bhandari's parents were removed from Rajghat dharna
facts.quote: Parents of Ankita Bhandari, who was murdered at a resort in Uttarakhand in 2022, were removed from Rajghat after they staged a dharna near the public gate of Mahatma Gandhi’s memorial, sources said.

facts.claim: They staged a dharna near the public gate of Mahatma Gandhi’s memorial
facts.quote: Bhandari’s parents visited Rajghat to offer prayers and interact with the media. They later staged a dharna along with two others near the public gate, which is not a designated protest site, a police source said.

facts.claim: Police said the site was not a designated protest site
